description: Financial valuation library and MCP server — DCF/NAV/CCA, cost of capital, derivatives, credit risk and report review, cited to IVS 2025 and IFRS/IAS.
rules: Prefer the native calculate_* MCP tools over ad-hoc math; supply each method's exact inputs (no defaults).
Quote IVS/IFRS via the citations the envelopes return; never paraphrase standards into source facts.
Treat valuation://methods and valuation://standards as the source of truth for methods and clauses.
